gate: tilelang SM80 FP8/FP4 GEMM compatibility (cheapest bounded GPU test, single kernel, GPU 0 only)
evidence: fp4_gemm JIT compile: OK on sm80
fp4_gemm device run: CUDA device-side assert — cute::SM89_16x8x32_F32E4M3E4M3F32_TN used without CUTE_ARCH_MMA_SM89_ENABLED (FP8 tensor-core mma does not exist on sm80)
fp8_gemm: same kernel family (T.gemm on FP8 operands), same expected failure
implication: Reference inference cannot use tilelang FP8/FP4 GEMMs on CMP 170HX. Fallback: BF16 W4A16/W8A16 dequant in linear() + BF16 tensor cores. Vision tower is plain BF16 SDPA and unaffected.
other_kernels: sparse_attn and hc_split_sinkhorn also use T.gemm on FP8-cast operands (same SM89 mma risk); both get PyTorch fallbacks in the SM80 shim
